name: family love
quote: She loved the adopted child as her own.
description: A deep sense that your very existence is interwoven with that of another person or people.

variations.name: baby love
variations.description: The deep sense that this little person is a part of you and depends on you.

variations.name: parent love
variations.description: A sense of gratitude and respect for the people that brought into the world.

variations.name: family duty
variations.description: Supporting a family member even if they don't invoke consistently positive feelings.
examples: He still helped his dad despite their differences.

variations.name: estranged family
variations.description: Family members who you're no longer talking to because they create more negative feelings than positive.
examples: There was a split in the family after the Thanksgiving argument.

commentaries.quote: Family is a unique gift that needs to be appreciated and treasured, even when they're driving you crazy.
Home is where you are loved the most and act the worst.

conditions: The sense that your existential self is interwoven with another person or people.
